patterns.note: The site uses a dark mode aesthetic with a deep charcoal background and light text, creating high contrast and a sophisticated, almost somber feel.
A distinctive, elegant, thin sans-serif font is used for large display headings, contrasting with a more standard, readable sans-serif for body text and functional elements.
The palette is highly restrained, primarily using deep charcoal/black for backgrounds and a soft, warm cream/light yellow for primary text and key accents.

As the user scrolls, the initial hero content (illustration and main title) scrolls out of view, while the 'Access the experience' button transforms into a smaller 'See more' button and sticks to the top center of the viewport. A cookie banner and an informational card remain fixed to the bottom corners.
Content sections are primarily text-based, introduced by large, elegant headings, with minimal imagery beyond the initial hero illustration.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with high contrast between deep background tones and light text/accent colors, creating a refined visual experience.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to transition elements: the hero content scrolls away, while a primary call-to-action button transforms in size and text, then sticks to the top of the viewport.
Fixed position elements (cookie banner, info card) remain visible in the viewport regardless of scroll depth, providing persistent access to information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, elegant, thin display headings (~4-5x body text) with a refined, readable sans-serif for body copy and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and cards, maintaining a clean, modern edge without being sharp or fully rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of calm and allowing elements to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, almost black background with elegant, thin, light typography creates a sophisticated and somewhat somber mood. The subtle, yet impactful, scroll-triggered transformation of the main CTA button from a central 'Access the experience' to a sticky 'See more' at the top is a unique and well-executed interaction.
